core_problem: Lack of data in 3D medical image processing, specifically for 3D semantic segmentation of brain tumors, compared to 2D natural image analysis.
methodology_summary: Proposing an asymmetric U-Net network that incorporates the EfficientNet model into the encoding branch. Initial encoder layers are used to reduce the third dimension of the 3D input to fit the 2D EfficientNet input.
datasets_eval: BraTS 2020 challenge (including 369 cases: 293 HGG and 76 LGG) using 4 modalities: native (T1), post-contrast T1-weighted (T1Gd), T2-weighted (T2), and T2-FLAIR.
empirical_results: The proposed method achieved promising performance on validation and test data from the BraTS 2020 challenge.
explicit_limitations: Treatment of LGG remains difficult due to variability in tumor size, location, histology, and biological behavior; tumor pressure deforms normal tissues, complicating distinction between normal and tumoral areas.
